hints.content: Bamboo plants grow at the rate of $3{-}10\,\,\text{cm}$ per day.  So any equation with a growth rate between $3$ and $10$ $\text{cm/day}$ will work.  What growth rates are represented by the various answer choices?

First, let’s consider $L=1.1t$.  If $t=\red1$ day, then $L=(1.1)(\red1)\,\text{cm}$, so the growth rate is $1.1$ $\text{cm/day}$.   Since $1.1$ is *not* between $3$ and $10$, this choice does not work.
Which of the remaining answer choices represent a growth rate that is between $3$ and $10$?

The only choices that have a growth rate between $3$ and $10$  are $L=7.1t$ and $L=9.3t$:

the growth rate for $L=7.1t$ is $7.1\,\text{cm/day}$, and

the growth rate for $L=9.3t$ is $9.3\,\text{cm/day}$.
**$L=7.1t$ and $L=9.3t$ could be descriptions of the growth of a bamboo plant.**

question.content:
